_readme: Level 3: The Numbers Tell a Story. Two clients in order: Bea (case_bea_001), then the company (case_marine_001). Documentation/Level3TheNumbersTellAStory.
caseIds are resource stems (Levels/Level_03/cases); the cases' own ids are L3-BEA-001 and L3-MARINE-001. The chapter phase (Level3ChapterRules), not the old case-to-case Continue, moves between them.
officeFeatures: the shared office systems Office_Level3 uses. No 'finale': the chapter ends with its own wrap-up (T14), never the old single-case finale.
Chapter 3 Career entry is enabled after completed Level 2 for the user-requested APK playtest (5 November 2026); T18 final release acceptance remains pending.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.
